beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those qualifications are part of the argument, not optional cautions around its edges.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An apparently successful decision can place its costs outside the decision-maker's account.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book follows that displacement toward people with less power to refuse.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Aggregate abundance does not establish that everyone can access food, care or shelter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nor does finding waste prove that every shortage has a simple logistical remedy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The argument requires attention to distribution, institutions and the location of risk.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This makes its critique more demanding than saying that consumption is always bad.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks whose missing options are paying for somebody else's visible improvement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A defense of limits must confront the history of unjust limits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book acknowledges that taboos have protected oppression as well as vulnerable goods.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It therefore does not propose restoring every inherited prohibition.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Instead, it asks readers to distinguish false barriers from protective boundaries.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some constraints can move through invention, while others preserve agency or shared resilience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That diagnosis needs evidence, criticism and a credible possibility of revision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The value of reading lies in learning to make the distinctions together.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Future people cannot negotiate many of the commitments being made in their name.
